comment: Video model registry. Muapi documents the submit/poll protocol but NOT a per-model price list or a complete parameter list. Entries below are limited to what the official docs show. Confirm the endpoint and parameters for any model on the Muapi playground before the first live run, and enter your own per-clip price estimate in Settings (prices are never invented here).

models.label: Kling Master · image-to-video
models.notes: Legacy endpoint. Current public MuAPI model API documentation does not confirm POST /kling-master. Select a verified model instead; do not submit paid requests with this legacy configuration.

models.label: Kling 2.1 Standard · image-to-video
models.notes: Official MuAPI model API page documents POST /api/v1/kling-v2.1-standard-i2v with prompt, image_url, aspect_ratio and duration (default 5). Price must be configured by the user. Verify access for your account before paid generation.
